rewards.redemption_notes: Points automatically transferred to Marriott Bonvoy account. Pay Yourself Back: redeem Marriott Bonvoy points for statement credit on airline tickets and Marriott hotel purchases, up to $750 total in redemptions per year ($100 for every 12,500 points).
